answer_1.quote: Generating medical reports automatically involves producing clinical descriptions based on the input visual medical images . This is similar to the task of image captioning , which aims to generate visual descriptions to describe the input images.

answer_2.quote: To access the performance of medical report generation models, we compute the widely-used evaluation metrics, i.e., BLEU , METEOR , ROUGE-L , which measure the match between the generated reports and ground truth reports.
